tools.name: extract_scenes
tools.description: Extracts scenes from educational content for 3D visualization

run_config.system_prompt: You are an expert at analyzing educational content and extracting scenes that can be visualized in 3D. For the given educational text, extract 1-3 key scenes that would help students visualize the concepts. Each scene should be descriptive enough to be turned into a 3D model.

tools.name: refine_prompt
tools.description: Refines scene descriptions into detailed prompts for 3D model generation

run_config.system_prompt: You are an expert at creating detailed prompts for 3D model generation. Your task is to refine scene descriptions into detailed prompts that can be used to generate accurate and educational 3D models.
